label: Acoustic Pop
description: warm acoustic guitar, clear storytelling, and a catchy sung chorus.

client_references.explanation: Warm acoustic-guitar pop with a conversational lead and a catchy sung chorus.

production_traits.musical_identity: warm acoustic pop built on fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar, clear conversational storytelling and a catchy sung chorus
instrumentation: fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar carrying the song
restrained kick and snare, brushes under the verses
small upright piano entering at the first opening
single vocal harmony on the final chorus
production_traits.rhythm: relaxed pocket, steady backbeat, guitar articulation carrying the groove

tempo.note: relaxed pocket; slower end for an intimate verse, faster end only when the story is already moving

production_traits.vocal_delivery: close, conversational and melodic lead with crisp consonants and modest embellishment, dry upfront vocal

energy_map.consequence: small guitar figure alone under the spoken line
energy_map.obstacle: clearer strum and warm bass enter when action becomes necessary
energy_map.choice: drums pull back to leave the decision exposed
energy_map.change: full strum, bass and shaker lift after the specific decision
energy_map.hook: sung chorus opens only after the decision
energy_map.cta: last chorus thins back to voice and guitar

production_traits.hook_guidance: compact repeated melodic phrase in the chorus that carries the emotional change; chorus lines shorter than verse lines; final return supports one CTA
production_traits.spoken_sung_split: spoken lines carry the consequence and bridging narration; verses are melodic and the chorus is sung; no rap passages
production_traits.delivery_constraints: keep the lead intelligible over the guitar, no vocal effect that blurs words, preserve the selected language, gender and accent
production_traits.word_fit: fit lyric phrases to natural guitar breathing, shorter chorus lines than verses, never machine-gun delivery to reach duration
production_traits.story_energy: warm and forward-leaning, with the lift earned by the decision rather than by the arrangement alone

duration_guidance.60: one verse, one chorus and the CTA; the spoken opener and the chorus both survive intact
duration_guidance.90: verse into chorus, a short second verse after the turn, final chorus and CTA
duration_guidance.120: two verse-chorus passes, a stripped bridge before the change, full final chorus
duration_guidance.180: add a second concrete scene and a guitar-only break before the decision
duration_guidance.300: three developed scenes, a quiet third verse, one earned key lift in the last chorus
duration_guidance.600: full narrative arc with instrumental answers between scenes; new consequential beats, never repeated filler

examples: A customer closes the bakery door; one dry spoken line names the loss, then warm strums support the owner's decision to ask for help.

section_hint: [Verse] conversational, [Pre-Chorus] strum opens, [Chorus] sung and warm, [Outro] one CTA
negative_constraints: no imitation of a named performer's voice
